body:
**WARNING:** The `.task` marker can contain bead ids this session never actually claimed, and this filter then hides a foreign in_progress bead from the parallel-work nudge.

The marker is written by the post-tool hook from command classification alone (`armSession` + `armDetail` in `packages/cli/src/commands/hooks.ts`), while the actual claim in `bro work enter` is best-effort: `claimBead` (work.ts:146) swallows the throw from `taskStore.claim` — which "throws when already claimed" (tasks.ts:73) — and returns `null`. So `bro work enter <bead-already-claimed-elsewhere>` arms the `task` aspect with that bead id even though the claim failed, and this `!mine.has(r.id)` filter drops a genuinely foreign in_progress bead — the exact collision the nudge exists to surface.

Ideally the claimed-outcome (or marker write) should be tied to the claim actually succeeding — e.g. record the bead id in the marker only on a successful claim, or have this filter double-check `r.assignee` — so the exclusion reflects real ownership.

---
Reply with `@kilocode-bot fix it` to have Kilo Code address this issue.
